name: What are common problems to avoid during basement trim installation?

mainEntity.name: What are common problems to avoid during basement trim installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common problems during basement trim installation include inaccurate measurements leading to gaps, uneven cuts at corners, and improper fastening which can result in loose trim. Not adequately addressing moisture concerns with appropriate materials or sealing can lead to future warping or mold. Additionally, insufficient surface preparation, such as not removing old adhesive or debris, can prevent new trim from sitting flush. Over-caulking or poor paint finishes can also detract from the final look.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid inaccurate measurements, uneven cuts, improper fastening, using non-moisture-resistant materials, poor surface prep, and messy finishing.
